items.title: Frank Goudie Interview
items.q: The only one I never heard was P-Roll.

ctx.x: Ridgely? The only one I never heard was P-Roll. It was when I went to Norland for 24 years in Chicago. Oh, yeah. I didn't get to hear. And he had a bunch of nice musicians with him. And I really wanted to hear, but I didn't get a chance.
Which, let's see, that would have been around after the war. See, that would have been probably from 20 to 23, wouldn't it? I'd say. Or 19. 1919 to 22 in there when you were in New Orleans.
